company.description:
"9 minutes to crack Bitcoin?" ⏱️ 

Google's new quantum whitepaper has the industry talking, but what's the reality behind the headlines?

Here is what you need to know:

1️⃣ The "9 minutes" estimate relies on idealized assumptions (perfect error correction, microsecond gate operations).

2️⃣ Lower resource estimates do not equal immediate attack capability. Massive engineering challenges remain.

3️⃣ The real challenge? Cryptographic upgrades take years. 2030–2035 is the critical window to be ready, not the exact date of an attack.

The goal isn't just to adopt post-quantum algorithms, but to build systems capable of continuous cryptographic adaptation. 🛡️

Read the full technical breakdown by our Chief Scientist here: https://t.co/Sm2FWBlyyd
